title: Training-Induced Escape from Token Clustering in a Mean-Field Formulation of Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.07772v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transformers perform inference by iteratively transforming token representations across layers. This layerwise computation has been studied empirically, and recent mean-field theories of Transformer dynamics explain how attention can drive token distributions toward clustering. However, existing analyses treat model parameters as prescribed, leaving open how training reshapes this clustering picture. We study this question in a noisy mean-field Transformer in which only a parameter-linear FFN is trained under $L^2$ regularization. We identify a training-induced phase of the inference dynamics across layers: after clustering in the early layers, the token distribution can leave the clustered regime near the final layers. A single gradient-descent update already produces this escape, and minimizers of the training objective satisfy an exponential turnpike bound under which clustering persists through the interior layers. translated_title: Transformer均场表述中训练诱导的Token聚簇逃逸
translated_abstract: Transformer通过在各层之间迭代地变换token表示来执行推理。这种逐层计算已被实证研究，而近期的Transformer动力学均场理论解释了注意力如何驱动token分布走向聚簇。然而，现有分析将模型参数视为预先给定的，留下了训练如何重塑这一聚簇图景的开放问题。我们在一个带噪声的均场Transformer中研究这一问题，其中仅在$L^2$正则化下训练一个参数线性的FFN。我们识别出一种由训练诱导的跨层推理动力学阶段：在前几层发生聚簇之后，token分布可以在接近最终层时离开聚簇区域。仅仅一次梯度下降更新就足以产生这种逃逸，且训练目标的最小值点满足一个指数型的turnpike（收费公路）界，在该界之下聚簇会在中间各层持续存在。
tldr: 该论文首次在均场Transformer理论中揭示了训练对推理动力学的重塑作用：仅训练一个$L^2$正则化的线性FFN，即可使token分布在早期层聚簇之后于最终层附近逃逸出聚簇状态，且一次梯度更新就足以产生这种逃逸。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals in a mean-field theory of Transformers how training reshapes inference dynamics: training only an $L^2$-regularized linear FFN makes the token distribution escape the clustered regime near the final layers after early-layer clustering, with even a single gradient-descent step producing this escape.
